strategy.summary: Reproduce sympy#26833 (issue #26821): Matrix.inv and Matrix.exp over RR[x,y,...] (float coefficients) produce huge Float atoms (~1e251) on the buggy commit c1b1d2d70164 (SymPy 1.13 era, inherits gh-25452 change 030101630865). Run the developer's added tests test_inverse_symbolic_float_issue_26821 and test_matrix_exponential_issue_26821 in sympy/matrices/tests/test_matrixbase.py; they should fail on the buggy revision (max Float atom >= 1e3 or cancel check failing) and pass once _inv_DM converts RR to QQ before inv_den and converts back.

build_commands: pip install -e . (run from the sympy source checkout at the buggy commit c1b1d2d70164)
pinned_because: mpmath has no documented constraint and no era ceiling in the supplied evidence; left unpinned and the latest compatible mpmath is chosen, which is an assumption rather than an evidenced requirement

strategy.test_command: python -m pytest sympy/matrices/tests/test_matrixbase.py -k 'test_inverse_symbolic_float_issue_26821' -x -q && python -m pytest sympy/matrices/tests/test_matrixbase.py -k 'test_matrix_exponential_issue_26821' -q --slow
strategy.success_criterion: On the buggy revision c1b1d2d70164 the test fails: the assertion max(abs(f) for f in Mi.atoms(Float)) < 1e3 is False because Mi contains Float atoms around 1e114-1e251 (and possibly the cancel identity check fails); on the fixed revision the test passes: M*Mi - eye(7) cancels to zeros and all Float atoms of Mi are below 1e3. The transition fail->pass is the criterion.
strategy.numerical_probe: Compute M from the test, Mi = M.inv(), and check max(abs(f) for f in Mi.atoms(Float)) against 1e3; a buggy revision yields values near 1e251.

input_output_examples.input: Mi = M.inv() where M is the 7x7 symbolic matrix with float entries 1.0 and symbols Tau, Tau_syn_in, Tau_syn_ex, C_m, Tau_syn_gap, __h
input_output_examples.expected_output: Mi with exact rational coefficients and no Float atom >= 1e3; (M*Mi - eye(7)).applyfunc(cancel) == zeros(7)

input_output_examples.input: Me = (t*M).exp() for the 7x7 matrix with symbols Tau, Tau_syn_in, Tau_syn_ex, C_m, Tau_syn_gap and t=__h

risks: The bug manifests only with symbolic entries carrying float coefficients (RR[x,y,...] domain); purely rational matrices will not reproduce it, so the test must keep the 1.0 entries.
Symbol names matter per the original report: renaming symbols changed the output, so the exact names Tau, Tau_syn_in, Tau_syn_ex, C_m, Tau_syn_gap and __h must be used.
The 1e3 threshold is a test assertion for this specific matrix, not a general tolerance; magnitude may differ across platforms or mpmath versions.
The exp test is marked @slow and requires the --slow flag (or the sympy slow test runner) to be selected; without it the test may be skipped rather than failing, which would not show the transition.

The evidence does not state the mpmath version or Python version; the bug depends on float rounding inside the DomainMatrix/polynomial path, so a different mpmath or platform libm could change whether the blow-up appears.
No architecture or sanitiser requirement is stated in the evidence; the defect is expected on x86_64 Linux with standard CPython, but this is not verified.

oracle.tolerance: 1e3 absolute bound on max Float atom in test assertion; no numerical tolerance for correctness
oracle.reference_source: sympy/matrices/tests/test_matrixbase.py developer test in the PR diff
oracle.why: Oracle is the test's own assertions: exact cancel identity plus Float magnitude bound.

strategy.fails_on_buggy: The assertion max(abs(f) for f in Mi.atoms(Float)) < 1e3 sees Float atoms around 1e114 to 1e251 on the buggy revision, so the comparison is False and the test fails; the cancel identity may also fail due to float rounding.
strategy.passes_on_fixed: With _inv_DM converting RR[...] to QQ[...] before inv_den and back afterward, Mi has exact rational coefficients, all Float atoms are below 1e3, and M*Mi - eye(7) cancels to zeros, so both assertions hold.
